title: Great Ci'en Monastery
subtitle: A key site for Xuanzang's translation work and Chang'an Buddhist institutions
shortSummary: Great Ci'en Monastery is a core institutional entry for connecting Xuanzang, translation, monastic networks and Chang'an's urban space.
curatorialDescription: A monastery was not a static backdrop but an institutional node where people, texts, objects, patronage and ritual activity met.
This record stays at institution level; the Giant Wild Goose Pagoda, translation spaces and manuscript holdings will become separate place and object records.
researchNote: Monastery history, translation sites, participants and archaeological or image records still require item-level sources and rights information.
